How to Get an Accurate Check
Avoid harsh direct sunlight glare or dark rooms. Natural outdoor shade shows true tobacco color and oil.
Place a flat leaf (patta) or a small pile of powder (choora) on plain paper or cloth, then drag the box over it.
3. Always Do the 3 Hand & Smell Checks
Check softness (fold test), smell inside the bundle (gaddi), and rub a pinch between your fingers for natural oil.
